question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs,
        COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    JOIN match m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    1.0 * pr.total_runs / pm.matches_played as avg_runs_per_match,
    1.0 * pr.total_runs / pr.balls_faced as batting_average
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
